data.one_liner: A floating widget for real-time API request logging and debugging in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a draggable floating widget that monitors API requests in real-time, displays JSON responses and headers, copies cURL commands, and simulates network conditions.
use_when: You want to inspect HTTP requests and responses directly on-device using a floating widget.
You need to quickly copy cURL commands from app network requests.
You need to simulate slow network conditions or offline states during testing.
avoid_when: You are not using the Dio networking library.
You require backend production logging integration without on-device UI overlays.
strengths: Includes a built-in network simulator for testing slow and offline conditions.
Supports copying cURL commands easily with a long tap.
Offers advanced JSON search, deep filtering, and web inspector support.
weaknesses: Tied directly to the Dio package ecosystem.
UI overlay might interfere with user flow if left enabled in production builds.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency, wrap your app or widget with FloatingLoggerControl, and add FloatingLoggerInterceptor to your Dio instance or use DioLogger.

alternatives.name: pretty_dio_logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer console output logging rather than a floating on-screen UI.

alternatives.name: inspector
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a more general debugging and layout inspection tool.
